name: guardian-mcp-server
description: Search, browse, and retrieve full article text from The Guardian's journalism archive (1999–present) via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search, browse, and retrieve full article text from The Guardian's journalism archive (1999–present) via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: guardian-mcp-server puts The Guardian's journalism archive (1999–present) behind MCP. guardian_search_articles runs full-text search across the archive with section, tag, contributor, and date filters; guardian_browse_content returns latest articles for a section or tag and discovers valid filter IDs. Search and browse previews are capped at 2,000 words. guardian_get_article retrieves complete HTML-stripped article text and metadata by article_id, without a word cap. Powered by the Guardian Open Platform (open-platform.theguardian.com).
